title: Black and White Patterned Kitchen Backsplash in Grand Prairie
summary: Decorative kitchen backsplash installation using a black and white patterned tile to create a strong visual focal point.
problem: The kitchen needed a backsplash that would add character while coordinating with the existing countertops, cabinets and appliances.
solution: Installed the patterned tile across the backsplash area with consistent alignment, detailed cuts and finished grout joints.
